title: Antoni Augustyn Deboli to King Stanisław August, cipher despatches from St Petersburg, 1788 (AGAD Zbiór Popielów 428; Unsolved Catalogue 417)

steps.what: AGAD letter lists ZbPop428.xml and ZbPop417.xml; scans on agadd2.
ZbPop 417 holds the cabinet decipherments of the older-code despatches too: 4 and 11 Jan 1788 aligned (1332 1332 = do do; 158 = ni x3).
Pairing by date: all despatches matched except nos. 038 and 039 of 13 May 1788.
No. 038 decoded with Daniel Bourdeau's 1789 key, unchanged and frozen: 95.3% of groups with a value.
Key completed on five 1788 pairs by DP alignment (K2, K3, K4, each frozen before its validation).
Held-out pair 11 Nov 1788 (341 groups): 0.862 of groups read as sense, exact words 0.750, characters 0.882; 200 shuffled controls at most 0.199 / 0.131 / 0.289.

validation.notes: The key was validated in the target's own pre-registered held-out test on the pair of 11 Nov 1788 (341 groups): 0.862 of groups read as sense against a best of 0.199 for 200 shuffled keys; 0.750 of words and 0.882 of characters. docs/_validate.py was not run: the Polish letter model cannot judge a key that writes syllables and stems.

outcome.method: key recovered based on adjacent plaintext
outcome.method_basis: Daniel Bourdeau's 1789 key, completed on 1788 cipher despatches aligned with their same-date cabinet decipherments, applied to the one despatch of the 1789-91 code that has no decipherment.
outcome.fraction_read_source: targets/deboli1788/reading/c038_1788-05-13.decoded.txt: 911 of 943 groups with a key value; held-out pair read as sense 0.862

gaps.item: 13 May 1788 no. 038: 32 groups without a value, alternatives unsettled

texts.summary: Dinner for the famous privateer lately taken into Russian service (very probably John Paul Jones); talk with Stackelberg on the King of Prussia's designs, the alliance project for the Diet ('to turn into a Confederation'), Russian aid 'when needed', Gdańsk.
texts.note: Key K4 = deboli1789 key_pass.tsv + 1788 additions; read_share is the held-out measure, not the 96.6% of groups with a value.

reading_review.note: Read as sentences 31 Oct 2026 (Polish, read in part, read_share 0.862): the first two thirds build a coherent account (dinner, John Paul Jones, Stackelberg on the Prussian threat, the project to be finalised at the Sejm turned into a confederation, Osterman, the two impressions); the last part has unread groups and [...] in most sentences, which is why the entry stays read in part. Raw old spelling, normalised in the translation.

prior.where: Cabinet decipherments of 110 of the 112 despatches of 1788 in AGAD ZbPop 417 (same-date Polish texts); none for 13 May 1788

human: Brice Dudout chose the target from the catalogue and set the rules (frozen key before validation, held-out checks, prior-work search the day of publication); AI agents transcribed, solved, checked and wrote up. Doubtful signs were settled by targeted visual review where stated.
